text:
incident-bot: ALERT: sustained GPU queue growth in us-west2 inference pools (p99 latency rising). autoscaler errors: 'scaleUp failed: quotaExceeded' — 04:12 UTC
ajay (oncall): on it. paging SRE. seeing lots of preempt events + OOM kills?
marta (sre): looking at the pool now — queue jumped from ~1.2k to 9.6k in 6m. pods Pending due to 'Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu' and nodegroup at max.
sarah (infra): autoscaler logs show repeated 'api rate limit' + AWS spot interruption spikes for the us-west2 spot pool. maxNodes reached (120).
ajay (oncall): impact: frontend error rate 2.8%, slow responses for batch embed jobs. customers on Dedicated experiencing throttling. cc @frank (support) for customer comms
frank (support): already getting support tickets: "inference timeouts" for two customers on Dedicated. escalating to AE.
len (eng-runtime): dumping autoscaler trace:
```
2026-06-12T04:08:33Z autoscaler: evaluateScaleUp -> desired: +60
2026-06-12T04:08:34Z aws: requestLaunch -> failed: InstanceLimitExceeded
2026-06-12T04:09:05Z autoscaler: error rebuilding capacity set: quotaExceeded
2026-06-12T04:10:11Z preempt: spot interruption rate elevated for us-west2-gpu-spot
```
ajay (oncall): we need immediate fallback. options: 1) expand to on-demand pool in us-west2 (costly), 2) route new requests to us-east1, 3) throttle noncritical batch queues, 4) manual policy to evict lower-priority jobs.
marta (sre): recommending 1 + 3. start on-demand scale while reducing batch concurrency. I'll flip routing if on-demand fails.
sarah (infra): starting on-demand instances now. running: `terraform apply -target=module.on_demand_pool_usw2 -var='capacity=80'`
ops (pager): deploybot triggered: On-demand pool provisioning started, ETA ~ 6m.
ajay (oncall): in parallel: apply temporary queue throttle: `POST /internal/queues/batch/control {"target_concurrency": 10}` — will limit batch jobs per tenant.
len (eng-runtime): applied throttle patch to queue manager. current queue drain rate doubled for priority jobs, batch now rate-limited.
marta (sre): noticed autoscaler still throwing rate-limit on API calls to cloud. I'm switching autoscaler to use exponential backoff -> patching now.
ajay (oncall): support — please file incident banner for customers in affected DEDICATED regions: short note that "we're mitigating GPU interruptions and routing to fallback capacity; some jobs may see increased latency".
frank (support): posted banner and notified AEs.
incident-bot: update: on-demand pool bootstrap completed, 72 on-demand GPUs joined nodegroup us-west2-ondemand by 04:18 UTC
sarah (infra): nodes came up but kube pods pending due to taints — fixing tolerations on server config. running `kubectl patch daemonset inference-runtime -n infra --patch '{...}'`
len (eng-runtime): toleration fix applied. pods starting. observed 500 new inference workers join the pool.
marta (sre): queue length peaked at 11.3k. now steady at 3.1k and falling. p95 latency back to acceptable range for priority tier. batch backlog will take ~18m to clear at current drain.
ajay (oncall): root cause summary for postmortem: rapid spot interruption wave in us-west2 depleted fallback spot capacity; autoscaler hit account/region limits and failed to failover to on-demand due to lack of preconfigured fallback policy; queue growth caused throttling.
len (eng-runtime): action items (short):
- add proactive on-demand fallback when spot interruption rate > X%
- increase autoscaler API retry/backoff and surface quota signals to ops UI
- add pre-warm on-demand buffer for peak windows
- improve per-customer throttling granularity

marta (sre): immediate runbook changes: ensure 'emergency_on_demand' toggle exists and docs for oncall. test failover in staging.
ajay (oncall): handoff: my shift ends in 28m. marta will take lead for post-incident and write timeline. I'll stay on thread for 10m then sign off.
frank (support): customers notified: two enterprise customers affected — AEs on calls. raising credit requests as needed.
ops (pager): monitoring: set alert suppression for reduced noise, keep one channel alert for residual throttles.
marta (sre): capturing timeline and logs to incident ticket INC-20260612-42. pulling kube events and autoscaler traces for postmortem.
ajay (oncall): thanks everyone. low-latency paths restored for priority traffic. keeping this open until backlog <500.
incident-bot: NOTE: escalate if backlog not <1000 in 40m.
marta (sre): acknowledged. continuing watch. will produce an impact statement and postmortem draft within 24h.
